name: Lamb Shank
siboNotes: Plain lamb shank is FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Avoid marinades containing garlic, onion, or high FODMAP ingredients.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like rosemary, thyme, and oregano
Braise with low FODMAP vegetables like carrots, parsnips, and fennel
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Slow cook for best tenderness - lamb shanks benefit from long, moist cooking methods
pairsWellWith: Red wine reduction (check wine FODMAP status)
Fresh herbs like mint and parsley
nutritionalHighlights: High in protein for muscle maintenance
Rich in iron for oxygen transport
Good source of B vitamins, especially B12
